title: Introduction to Kenyan Sign Language: Main Exam, 12 April 2019
programme: Bachelor of Education in Special Needs
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: Explain what Kenyan Sign Language is.
Outline the three approaches in oralism.
State two models in bilingual education.
Identify the two types of manual alphabets used in the world today.
Explain the following terms as used in Kenyan Sign Language.
Explain how cued speech is used in communication with the deaf.
Identify the two types of manual skills.
State the four elements of a sign. j) Describe how speed of movement affects the meaning of a sign.

items.text: Discuss factors one should observe in order to finger spell and read finger-spelled letters properly.
Using appropriate examples, discuss different handshapes in Kenyan Sign Language.
Using appropriate examples, discuss different places of articulation in Kenyan Sign Language.
Explain the four features used to mark plural and singular.
